active_chat_goal: Act as the main responsible worker for AI-Statistician: take the hard central AgentRuntime and evaluation work, proactively coordinate other Codex/GitHub branches, preserve strict evidence boundaries, and keep driving the repo toward a live autonomous AI Statistical Theory Lab rather than side audits or easy patches.
main_objective: Build and honestly evaluate one general LLM-driven statistical research loop that derives theory, generates and executes scientific code, uses task-bound formal RAG, iterates against real environment feedback, and closes exact intended Lean theorems across unrelated task families.
current_lane: Shrink the canonical runtime toward an outer research graph plus model-owned theory, scientific-coding, and formalization workspaces. Runtime compiles an already model-authored plan, executes real tools, returns raw observations, stores content-addressed lineage, enforces budgets and evidence gates, and does not spend model calls on routine routing or author source changes.

canonical_authoring_contract.model_responsibility: The source-producing LLM receives the exact current source, immutable target identity, raw compiler or sandbox output, semantic-review observations, and model-selected retrieval results. It chooses the next action and authors every byte of the next complete source artifact.
canonical_authoring_contract.runtime_responsibility: Runtime executes model-requested tools, returns observations, binds exact source hashes, enforces resource and lineage budgets, persists checkpoints, and applies independent semantic and kernel evidence gates.
canonical_authoring_contract.forbidden_runtime_behavior: Runtime must not patch source, infer a mathematical correction, provide theorem-family answers, encode Lean grammar or tactic recipes, select imports, leak runtime-authored CLI recipes into producer prompts, or substitute a hidden repair agent.
canonical_authoring_contract.why_a_harness_exists: The harness is an execution and evidence boundary. An LLM assertion that code compiled is not evidence; the exact model-authored bytes must be checked in the configured Python, R, or Lean environment and bound to the returned diagnostics.
canonical_authoring_contract.tool_ownership: The model chooses whether and when to search, replace the complete source, and check it. A successful model-requested check hands the exact current source hash directly to independent semantic review; no redundant submit action or runtime-authored edit exists.
canonical_authoring_contract.structured_output_regeneration: The historically named llm_json_repair helper asks the same model to regenerate a complete structured object from its rejected response and raw validator errors. It performs no local semantic or source repair.
canonical_authoring_contract.legacy_policy: Historical *_repair_executor, replay-patch, attached repair-eval, post-runtime bridge, and candidate-synthesis paths are compatibility and calibration code. Every full-live run now rejects them before provider calls; they are not the product architecture.

AlgorithmEngineer and SimulationEvaluator are still separate control surfaces. A downstream consumer failure now returns raw evidence to the source producer, but the central runtime still contains a dedicated branch. The next structural step is one scientific-coding workspace that owns source generation, unit execution, integration execution, scoring, and bounded candidate search.

Blackboard artifacts and the 1492-field audit manifest remain too large. Compact task refs remove recursive trace/work-order copies, but substantive artifact schemas still need narrow ArtifactRef projections at handoff boundaries rather than full packet replication.
The formal authoring session is still whole-source oriented; a mature tactic-state action provider and trained LeanDojo/ReProver-style policy remain absent.

Independent formal target review currently conflates statement semantics with proof completion and library API uncertainty; these evidence dimensions need separate outputs and owners without a deterministic verdict override.
